excerpt:
On the two large public cases, independent host recording gives:

| Source | Projection programs per large case | Weight scratch A/B |
|---|---:|---:|
| Generic | 2,048 |0 /0 |
| Original serial417660 |16,384 |0 /0 |
| Direct5a7009 |2,097,152 |0 /0 |
| Packed-vectorf17123 |131,072 |4 /1 MiB |

Thus the newer vector scheme reduces program count16x but still misses the
actual target threshold. Both vector paths process one token per program;
they do not reuse weights across token rows inside a program. Program counts
alone do not locate the runtime bottleneck or predict matrix-unit performance.
